description: This file defines the CrashReporter class that interfaces with Firebase Crashlytics to report crash-related information and log user-related data.

classes.name: CrashReporter
classes.description: A class that handles reporting of crashes and user identification to Firebase Crashlytics.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user ID for crash reporting.

methods.name: setCustomKey
methods.description: Sets a custom key-value pair for crash reporting.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs an exception to Firebase Crashlytics.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message to Firebase Crashlytics.

methods.name: logNonFatal
methods.description: Logs a non-fatal error to Firebase Crashlytics, with optional details.
